answer: The ripple chain is verified at intake and violet publishes each anchor. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 9 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 9 epochs old, anchored at a opal checkpoint. That bill is paid per identity, so 231 aliases cost 311 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
